# Is your tax code right, and are you overpaying?

> Free UK tax code checker for 2026/27: decode any PAYE tax code (1257L, BR, 0T, K, M1/W1 emergency), see if your payslip tax matches it, estimate an overpayment, and work out what your code should be. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
